title: The kb MCP coord tools and the coord hook use different stores by default, so a session's coord_digest never sees the hook's intents
goal: SP-xo45jvbj review G5 (ST-xwop6rv5, sprint goal): kb_mcp's coord tools use KB_COORD_STORE or the server and fail with 'no store' when neither is set, while coord_hook.py defaults to <git common dir>/kb-coord/coord.sqlite and the kb-research dedup step names that path only in prose; nothing sets KB_COORD_STORE for the MCP server. With no KB_COORD_STORE and no KB_COORD_URL, the kb MCP coord tools (and coord.py dedup as the skill runs it) use the same default store as the hook.

run:
import json,os,sys
for k in ('KB_COORD_STORE','KB_COORD_URL','KB_COORD_KEY_FILE'):os.environ.pop(k,None)
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kb_mcp
r=kb_mcp.handle({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'coord_digest','arguments':{'key':['ST-xo45jvbj'],'lines':3}}})
res=r.get('result') or {};print(json.dumps(res)[:300]);sys.exit(0 if res.get('isError') is False else 1)
